methods.label: Equate the melted volume and cone capacity
methods.explanation:
Equal diameters mean that the sphere and the cone's circular base have the same radius. Call this radius \(r>0\), and let the cone's height be \(h>0\).

The melted ice cream has \(75\%=\frac34\) of the sphere's volume. Since it exactly fills the cone, the supplied volume formulas give
\[
\frac{\pi r^2h}{3}
=\frac34\left(\frac{4\pi r^3}{3}\right)
=\pi r^3.
\]
Because \(r>0\), we may divide by \(\pi r^2/3\), obtaining \(h=3r\). Therefore the height-to-radius ratio is \(\boxed{3:1}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
